1.note: Conversation with uniqueName order-<id>, JSON attributes {orderId, listingId}, two chat participants (created server-side when missing)

2.note: no custom message type, but message JSON attributes (4 KB) are the documented place for structured data; the card lives there, the server edits attributes over REST, clients get messageUpdated

3.note: no content filter and no report API. Moderation ran in the pre-event onMessageAdd webhook (Twilio's documented rewrite/reject mechanism) with our regex: 4/4 blocked, 0 false positives; needs a public URL. Reporting: unavailable (nothing to report to)

4.note: no email; browser push via FCM is native; SMS/WhatsApp participants can carry the conversation to a phone (costs money)

5.note: no translation feature; Sendbird (Pro+) and Stream/CometChat translate natively

6.note: conversation.add('agent_sam') (falls back to REST participants.create); up to 1000 participants, 50 non-chat. Twist: addPhoneParticipant adds the seller's phone over SMS/WhatsApp (costs money; not run until confirmed)

7.note: read horizon via setAllMessagesRead + participantUpdated (the SDK does not advance it itself); typing() signal with timeout; media via FormData with 300 s temporary URLs. Chat-side delivery receipts do not exist
